title.en: An Act Authorizing the Provincial Board of La Union to Use the Sum Appropriated By Act Numbered Twenty-Seven Hundred and Eighty-Six for the Construction of An Agricultural School in Said Province, for School Purposes.

text.en:
The Provincial Board of La Union is hereby authorized to use the sum of thirty-nine thousand
pesos appropriated by the Philippine Legislature for the construction of an agricultural school in said
province, for school purposes which the said provincial board, with the approval of the Director of Education,
deems in advisable.

This Act shall take effect on its approval.
Approved, November 27, 1929.
